description_en: Retrieves the details of a service rollout
kebab_example: aliyun eas describe-service-rollout --cluster-id cn-shanghai --service-name foo --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeServiceRollout

parameters.help_en: The region ID where the service is deployed
parameters.name: cluster_id

RequestId.description_en: The request ID. This ID is unique to each request and is used for troubleshooting
RequestId.description_zh: 请求ID。每次请求返回的唯一标识，用于问题排查和追踪
RequestId.title_en: 请求ID。每次请求返回的唯一标识，用于问题排查和追踪。

Rollout.description_en: Details of the service rollout, including the rollout strategy (`Strategy`) and execution status (`Status`)
Rollout.description_zh: 发布策略信息。包含策略配置（Strategy）和执行状态（Status）

Status.description_en: The current progress and phase of the rollout
Status.description_zh: 发布策略执行状态。包含当前发布进度和阶段信息

CurrentRevision.description_en: The identifier for the currently running revision
CurrentRevision.description_zh: 当前版本。当前正在运行的版本标识
CurrentRevision.title_en: 当前版本。当前正在运行的版本标识。

NextBatchStartTime.description_en: The scheduled start time for the next batch
NextBatchStartTime.description_zh: 下一批开始更新的时间

Phase.description_en:
The current release phase. Valid values:

`Pending`: The rollout is waiting to start.

`Running`: The rollout is in progress.

`Paused`: The rollout is paused.

`Completed`: The rollout is complete.

`Failed`: The rollout has failed
Phase.description_zh:
发布阶段。可能值：
Pending：等待开始发布
Running：发布进行中
Paused：发布已暂停
Completed：发布已完成
Failed：发布失败
